Fact.Name: Schedule D line 3
Fact.Description: Schedule D (2025): line label "...Form(s) 8949 with Box C or Box I checked" (ST, no 1099-B). Form 8949 instr. (2025) p.3.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 5 — net short-term gain or loss from Schedule K-1
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Schedule D (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sd--dft.pdf, SHA-256 0df9af0711964b3198ea04bb0037b29d6afa85578a671553daed46251630b5f1), PDF p. 2, line 5: "Net short-term gain or (loss) from partnerships, S corporations, estates, and trusts from Schedule(s) K-1". This line is the whole-dollar total of Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 3 (scheduleE /scheduleEEstateK1NetShortTermCapitalGain) plus Form 1065 box 8 and Form 1120-S box 7 (scheduleE /scheduleEK1NetShortTermCapitalGain). 2026 draft Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), PDF p. 3. Partner's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) (2025), PDF p. 15, Box 8. Shareholder's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) (2025), PDF p. 7, Box 7. A loss still stops the return. 26 U.S.C. 6102(a). $0 when there is no K-1 capital gain.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 6 — short-term capital loss carryover
Fact.Description: Prior-year short-term capital loss carryover (Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet, Schedule D instr. (2025) p.10). Shown in parentheses on the form; IRC §1212(b)(1)(A).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 7 — net short-term capital gain or loss
Fact.Description: Schedule D Part I line 7: combine lines 1a through 6 (lines 1a and 4 are $0 in scope; line 5 is Schedule K-1 net short-term capital gain; line 6 short-term carryover is subtracted). 2026 draft Schedule D, PDF p. 2, line 7. Schedule D instr. (2025) p.10 (lines 6/14).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 8b
Fact.Description: Schedule D (2025): line label "...Form(s) 8949 with Box D or Box J checked" (LT, basis reported). Form 8949 instr. (2025) pp.3–4.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 9
Fact.Description: Schedule D (2025): line label "...Form(s) 8949 with Box E or Box K checked" (LT, basis not reported). Form 8949 instr. (2025) pp.3–4.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 10
Fact.Description: Schedule D (2025): line label "...Form(s) 8949 with Box F or Box L checked" (LT, no 1099-B). Form 8949 instr. (2025) pp.3–4.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 12 — net long-term gain or loss from Schedule K-1
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Schedule D (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sd--dft.pdf, SHA-256 0df9af0711964b3198ea04bb0037b29d6afa85578a671553daed46251630b5f1), PDF p. 2, line 12: "Net long-term gain or (loss) from partnerships, S corporations, estates, and trusts from Schedule(s) K-1". This line is the whole-dollar total of Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 4a (scheduleE /scheduleEEstateK1NetLongTermCapitalGain) plus Form 1065 box 9a and Form 1120-S box 8a (scheduleE /scheduleEK1NetLongTermCapitalGain). 2026 draft Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), PDF p. 3. Partner's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) (2025), PDF p. 15, Box 9a. Shareholder's Instructions for Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) (2025), PDF p. 7, Box 8a. A loss still stops the return. 26 U.S.C. 6102(a). $0 when there is no K-1 capital gain. The QDCG worksheet reads line 15, which includes this line. Form 8960 line 5a reads Form 1040 line 7a, which includes line 16.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 14 — long-term capital loss carryover
Fact.Description: Prior-year long-term capital loss carryover (Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet, Schedule D instr. (2025) p.10). Shown in parentheses on the form; IRC §1212(b)(1)(B).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 13 — capital gain distributions
Fact.Description: #86b: Schedule D Part II line 13. Schedule D instr. (2025) https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040sd.pdf p. 2, Capital Gain Distributions: "Enter on Schedule D, line 13, the total capital gain distributions paid to you during the year, regardless of how long you held your investment. This amount is shown in box 2a of Form 1099-DIV." p. 11, Line 13: "See Capital Gain Distributions, earlier." Total 1099-DIV box 2a in whole dollars (dividends /totalCapitalGainDistributions), only when Schedule D is filed; otherwise box 2a goes directly on Form 1040 line 7a (dividends /capitalGainDistributionsWithoutScheduleD). Form 2439 box 1a is not supported.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 15 — net long-term capital gain or loss
Fact.Description: Schedule D Part II line 15: combine lines 8a through 14 (lines 8a and 11 are $0 in scope; line 12 is Schedule K-1 net long-term capital gain; line 13 is capital gain distributions; line 14 long-term carryover is subtracted). 2026 draft Schedule D, PDF p. 2, line 15. Schedule D instr. (2025) p.10 (lines 6/14).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 16 — combine lines 7 and 15
Fact.Description: Net capital gain or loss before §1211(b) limitation.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 21 — capital loss limitation
Fact.Description: If line 16 is a loss, the deductible amount against ordinary income is the lesser of the loss or the §1211(b) limit ($3,000 / $1,500 MFS). Schedule D instr. (2025) p.14 (Line 21); IRC §1211(b). Shown as a positive amount on the form.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 17 Yes: lines 15 and 16 are both gains
Fact.Description: Checked when line 16 and line 15 are both more than zero, so there is a net capital gain (IRC 1222(11)) taxed under IRC 1(h).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 17 No
Fact.Description: Checked when line 16 is a gain but line 15 is zero or a loss. Line 17 is skipped (neither box) when line 16 is zero or a loss.

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 11
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/i1040sd--dft.pdf, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 11: the total of all amounts reported as unrecaptured section 1250 gain on a Schedule K-1, Form 1099-DIV, or Form 2439. On a supported return the only source is Form 1099-DIV box 2b (dividends /totalUnrecapturedSection1250Gain), in whole dollars. Schedule K-1, Form 2439, and Form 1099-R still stop. Lines 1 through 10 and line 12 are $0 on that path: Form 4797 line 7, installment sales (Form 6252), and a sale of a partnership interest stop at scheduleD /flowKnockoutUnrecaptured1250Gain rather than being half-filled.

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 17
Fact.Description: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040sd.pdf, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet lines 14 through 17. Line 14 is lines 1 through 4 of the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet. On a supported return that is Form 1099-DIV box 2d (a gain) or $0. Section 1202 gain and a sale of a collectible still stop. Line 15 is the loss on Schedule D line 7, entered as a negative amount, or $0 when line 7 is zero or a gain. Line 16 is the long-term capital loss carryover from Schedule D line 14, entered as a negative amount. Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 11 code D stops, so it is not added. Line 17: "If the result is a (loss), enter it as a positive amount. If the result is zero or a gain, enter -0-." A box 2d gain with a line 7 loss or a line 14 carryover stops at /flowKnockoutCollectibles28RateGainNetting, so this line is not asked to net that gain against a loss. With no such loss the combination is zero or a gain and this line is the Schedule D line 7 loss, if any, plus Schedule D line 14.

Fact.Name: Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 18
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 18: subtract line 17 from line 13. Line 13 is the sum of lines 9 through 12, which on a supported return is line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-. If more than zero, enter the result on Schedule D line 19.

Fact.Name: 28% Rate Gain Worksheet line 4
Fact.Description: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040sd.pdf p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet line 4: "Enter the total of any collectibles gain reported to you on: Form 1099-DIV, box 2d; Form 2439, box 1d; and Schedule K-1 from a partnership, S corporation, estate, or trust." On a supported return the only source is Form 1099-DIV box 2d (dividends /totalCollectibles28RateGain), in whole dollars. Form 2439 and Schedule K-1 collectibles gain still stop: a sale of a collectible is scheduleD /flowKnockoutCollectibles, and Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) box 9b and Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) box 8b are scheduleE /scheduleEK1s/*/hasOtherK1Amount. Lines 1 through 3 are $0 on that path. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(4), 1(h)(5).

Fact.Name: 28% Rate Gain Worksheet line 7
Fact.Description: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040sd.pdf p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet line 7: "Combine lines 1 through 6. If zero or less, enter -0-. If more than zero, also enter this amount on Schedule D, line 18." Lines 1 through 3 are $0 (section 1202 gain and collectibles reported on Form 8949 or Forms 4684, 6252, 6781 and 8824 still stop). Line 4 is /rateGainWsLine4. Line 5 is the long-term capital loss carryover from Schedule D line 14, and line 6 is a loss on Schedule D line 7. A box 2d greater than $0 with either of those stops at /flowKnockoutCollectibles28RateGainNetting, so they are not subtracted here. On a return that is not stopped, line 7 equals line 4. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(F).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 18 — 28% rate gain
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Schedule D line 18 and 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet line 7. Entered only when line 17 is Yes (lines 15 and 16 are both gains). Otherwise the form skips lines 18 through 21 and this line is $0. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(F), 1(h)(4), 1(h)(5). Not added to line 15: Form 1099-DIV box 2d is already inside box 2a. No ExportZero: the form says "if any," so a zero prints blank.

Fact.Name: Knockout: box 2d with a capital loss the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet would net
Fact.Description: 2025 Instructions for Schedule D, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040sd.pdf p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet lines 5 and 6. Line 5 is the long-term capital loss carryover from Schedule D line 14 (Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 11 code D still stops and is not added). Line 6 is a loss on Schedule D line 7. Those lines reduce collectibles gain before it is entered on Schedule D line 18. They are not computed. True when Form 1099-DIV box 2d (dividends /totalCollectibles28RateGain) is more than $0 and Schedule D line 7 is a loss or Schedule D line 14 is more than $0. The box 2d total is tested first, so this fact is complete and false when box 2d is $0 even if Schedule D line 7 is still incomplete. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(4), 1(h)(5).

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 19 — unrecaptured section 1250 gain
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Schedule D line 19 and 2026 draft Instructions for Schedule D, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet line 18. Entered only when line 17 is Yes (lines 15 and 16 are both gains). Otherwise the form skips lines 18 through 21 and this line is $0. 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(1)(E), 1(h)(6). Not added to line 13: Form 1099-DIV box 2b is already inside box 2a. No ExportZero: the form says "if any," so a zero prints blank.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 20 Yes: lines 18 and 19 zero or blank, no Form 4952
Fact.Description: Checked when line 17 is Yes, lines 18 and 19 are not more than zero, and every other input that can put an amount on line 18 or line 19 is complete and false. Line 18 (28% rate gain, 26 U.S.C. 1(h)(4) and 1(h)(5)) is Form 1099-DIV box 2d after the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet (/scheduleDLine18). A sale of a collectible (scheduleD /flowKnockoutCollectibles) and section 1202 gain (scheduleD /flowKnockoutForm8949CodeQ) still stop. Other unrecaptured section 1250 gain (scheduleD /flowKnockoutUnrecaptured1250Gain) and Form 1099-DIV boxes 2c, 9, and 10 still stop. Box 14 greater than $0 stops except on the supported path (no computed state return, an income-tax resident state, and box 15 the resident state) (dividends /flowKnockoutDividendUnsupportedBoxes). Box 8 and boxes 15-16 do not, except a box 16 amount that differs from box 1a plus box 2a on a computed state return (Pennsylvania, Illinois, North Carolina, Arizona, Massachusetts, or Idaho) (dividends /flowKnockoutDividendStateDistribution). Form 1099-DIV box 2b is Schedule D line 19. When line 18 or line 19 is more than zero, line 20 No is checked and tax is figured on the Schedule D Tax Worksheet (scheduleD3 /usesScheduleDTaxWorksheet). When both are zero, tax is figured on the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet, matching this box. Form 4952 is never filed: investment interest stops the return.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 20 No: use the Schedule D Tax Worksheet
Fact.Description: 2026 draft Schedule D line 20: "Are lines 18 and 19 both zero or blank and you are not filing Form 4952?" No when line 17 is Yes and line 18 or line 19 is more than zero. Line 18 is the 28% rate gain from Form 1099-DIV box 2d. Line 19 is unrecaptured section 1250 gain from box 2b. Section 1202 gain and a sale of a collectible still stop. Form 4952 still stops.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 22 Yes: qualified dividends on Form 1040 line 3a
Fact.Description: Line 22 is answered when line 17 is not Yes (line 16 zero or a loss, or line 17 No). Yes when Form 1040 line 3a qualified dividends (IRC 1(h)(11)) are more than zero.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 22 No
Fact.Description: Line 22 is answered when line 17 is not Yes, and No when Form 1040 line 3a qualified dividends are zero.

Fact.Name: Capital gains or losses for Form 1040 line 7
Fact.Description: Form 1040 line 7: net capital gain, or limited net capital loss after §1211(b). If Schedule D line 16 ≥ 0 → line 16; if loss → GreaterOf(line 16, −limit).

Fact.Name: Has net long-term capital gain
Fact.Description: True when Schedule D line 15 > 0 — preferential §1(h) rates may apply (breakpoints Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §4.03 p.13). Feeds the QDCG Tax Worksheet in scheduleD3.xml.
